displayName: Niche 3: Thân phận bí mật / Thiên kim ẩn danh / Nằm vùng
description: Identity-reveal urban drama where a powerful person (hidden heiress, secret owner, lost daughter, undercover investigator, anonymous benefactor, retired prodigy) is mistaken for someone powerless, lets the misjudgment compound, and stages a public proof of real status. The engine is identity asymmetry and timed reveal, not rich-poor courtship and not corporate boardroom paperwork.
emotionalAxis: underestimated heroine wound, hidden power held in reserve, suspense of identity, delayed reveal pressure, urban status pressure, dignity restored through proof rather than apology
coreKeywords: no one knew who she was
she was the real owner all along

chapterArcDefaults.hookStyle: someone with real power is mistaken for someone powerless and chooses, for now, not to correct the misjudgment

humiliationPacing: she is mistaken for staff, intern, applicant, or nobody at the door
small clues to her real identity are seen and dismissed as coincidence
antagonists brag about how powerless she is, captured on the record
she absorbs the mistreatment on purpose to gather evidence
a colleague or rival uses the misjudgment to assign her the worst tasks
she is told to use the service entrance / the side hallway / the back row
the antagonist makes a decision they could only make if she were powerless
her alias is publicly humiliated while her real authority watches in silence
revengeActivation: the formal identity reveal happens in the same room that mistreated her alias
a signature, DNA result, share certificate, or board minute lands as proof
press release, ID badge, or family lawyer confirms the heritage publicly
the antagonist's bragging recording becomes evidence after the reveal
she keeps the alias's promises (to the kind characters) using her real authority
the disguise is removed only after the antagonist crosses a line
the underestimated alias is re-credited for the work she did before the reveal
she refuses to accept apology that erases the alias — both names get credit
dignityRecoveryTiming: late chapter public reveal where the heritage / ownership / credential is documented in the same venue that mistreated her alias

belongsHere: identity asymmetry and delayed public reveal as the central engine
hidden heiress / secret owner / lost daughter / anonymous benefactor / retired prodigy alias
documented reveal (DNA, signature, share certificate, badge, press release)
antagonists locked in by their own bragging because they thought she was powerless
alias gets re-credited so the underestimated work is not erased after the reveal
doesNotBelongHere: rich-poor romance courtship without an identity reveal engine (-> Niche 1)
corporate paper marriage / hostile takeover (-> Niche 8)
family inheritance and custody papers (-> Niche 4)
campus bullying with student-stage reveal (-> Niche 10)
discrimination on protected attributes as the wound (-> Niche 7)
